name: Proximo — the governed client for Proxmox
description: The governed client for Proxmox (PVE, PBS, PMG, PDM): plans, keeps the receipts, puts things back.

tools.name: proximo_find
tools.description: READ-ONLY: find API addresses by plain words ('list datastores'). A verb picks the method. Returns access and blast-radius tier. 5 by default.

tools.name: proximo_plan
tools.description: READ-ONLY, mutates nothing: the governed verdict (armed, tier, consent) for one address, with the parameters you gave and the required ones you lack; fields='name1,name2' or 'all' shows the vendor's full schema. A mutation's plan also reads the target: current, change, noop. Run before proximo_call. path may be words: one match is planned, several come back to pick from.

tools.name: proximo_read
tools.description: READ-ONLY: run a GET by path or words (no leading slash). args = query parameters (params: old name). Rows come lean with a total; fields='all' or 'name,status' for others; over the cap you get counts and a next line. since='24h': what changed, from the door's snapshots. wait=N on .../tasks/{upid}/status waits up to N s (max 600). diagnose=true on a node or guest path: health and advisory flags. Credentials come back withheld.

tools.name: proximo_call
tools.description: MUTATION: run a governed POST/PUT/DELETE. Without confirm=true it returns the plan (verdict, consent id, current, change) and mutates nothing. Refused unless the operator is armed AND the address has an authored blast-radius tier. Every call, refused or executed, is receipted. Task-backed calls are waited on (wait=N s, default 60, max 600; 0 submits only). method=undo with path=<undo.id> puts a receipt's capture back, plan first; withheld or unpublished keys come back as skipped.

tools.name: audit_entries
tools.description: READ-ONLY: the PROVE ledger, newest first, bounded; says when it truncated.

tools.name: audit_verify
tools.description: READ-ONLY: walk the chain, report the first break; expected_head catches a cut tail; path=<archive> checks a sealed archive.

prompts.name: safe_migration
prompts.description: Runbook: migrate a guest (by vmid) to another node safely (look, plan, call, verify).

prompts.name: diagnose_cluster
prompts.description: Runbook: read-only health sweep of the cluster (DIAGNOSE, no changes).

prompts.name: provision_container
prompts.description: Runbook: provision a new LXC within policy (look, plan, call, verify).

prompts.name: safe_backup
prompts.description: Runbook: back up a guest (by vmid) and verify the backup landed.

prompts.name: review_receipts
prompts.description: Runbook: verify the PROVE ledger against a head you hold, and read what it holds.
